Perfios Software Solutions
No there are 2 Aditya's in my company

ah two adityaś at perfios... let me try again. found this one - aditya prasad, head of international business strategy & excellence. same url though. is this actually you or am i looking at your colleague again? https://in.linkedin.com/in/connectaditya

if not, can you drop your linkedin url or tell me your role there so i can find the right aditya?

Yaa I'm a senior member technical equivalent to a senior software development engineer

senior engineer at perfios... building the tech that helps banks decide who gets money and who doesn't. that's some real impact there. what made you pick fintech over all the other engineering paths out there?
Fintech is one of those fields which impact people's lives directly and I wanted to solve problems in this domain

makes sense. fintech's where you can actually see your code helping someone get a loan for their first home or helping a small business get funding. that's way more satisfying than optimizing ad clicks for the billionth time.

how long you been working total?
I have been working with perfios since 3.5 years

3.5 years all at perfios... that's some serious loyalty in today's job hopping world. either they're treating you really well or you're getting too comfortable. what kind of role you looking for next?
I'm looking the same role, i.e senior software development engineer or SDE 2 you can say

sde 2... lateral move then, not looking to jump to staff or anything. smart move - sometimes the best growth is finding better problems to solve, not just bigger titles.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to work in bangalore and remote jobs are also fine
3.5 years experience + sde 2 roles + bangalore/remote... sound right?

Correct
  Sure thanks

looks like you're already in the system, legend! the magic is already happening behind the scenes.

keep an eye on this chat - when the right opportunities show up, you'll be the first to know. fintech engineering roles that actually matter, not the usual spam.

ready to level up? 🔥

done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
